read.thesis: Lululemon cut FY26 revenue to $10.35–10.5B (down 5–7%) and EPS to $9.48–9.73, with Q3 operating margin near 6.5%; demand weakness is traffic-driven, not supply-side discipline.

capex.quote: Expected to be between $680 million and $700 million for the full year

triggers.label: FY26 EPS cut to $9.48–9.73
triggers.quote: we now expect diluted earnings per share in the range of $9.48 to $9.73 versus EPS of $13.26 in 2025

triggers.label: Q3 operating margin ~6.5% vs 17%
triggers.quote: we expect it to be approximately 6.5% versus 17% in Q3 2025

triggers.label: Store openings cut 40 → 35
triggers.quote: We're now planning approximately 35 net new store openings this year, down from our guidance of approximately 40 last quarter

triggers.label: Units down 7%, dollars down 1%
triggers.quote: On a unit basis, inventory decreased approximately 7%

guidance.quote: We now expect revenue to be in the range of $10.35 billion to $10.5 billion, down 5% to 7% relative to 2025.
we now expect diluted earnings per share in the range of $9.48 to $9.73 versus EPS of $13.26 in 2025
We're now planning approximately 35 net new store openings this year, down from our guidance of approximately 40 last quarter.
For Q3, we expect revenue in the range of $2.29 billion to $2.32 billion, representing a decline of 10% to 11%.
we now expect capital expenditures to be approximately $680 million to $700 million

prior_guidance_check.quote: down from our guidance of approximately 40 last quarter
North America finished down 8% for Q2, slightly ahead of our guidance.

red_flags.label: Comparable sales down 10%; Americas comp down 12%
red_flags.quote: Total Comparable Sales -- Decreased 10% on a constant dollar basis, driven by a 12% decline in the Americas segment.

red_flags.label: Q3 margin collapse and EPS $0.93–0.98
red_flags.quote: We expect earnings per share in the third quarter to be in the range of $0.93 to $0.98 versus EPS of $2.59 a year ago.

red_flags.label: Incoming CEO reviewing strategy
red_flags.quote: We're excited our incoming CEO, Heidi O'Neill, joins us next week.

red_flags.label: Tariff refund receivable excluded from guidance
red_flags.quote: We have not reflected the remaining $105 million in our forward guidance.

evasions.quote: I think too early to share beyond the guidance that we shared for '26
we will share more about how we see square footage growth for '27 when we give guidance in March
